cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women, 100 with uterine fibroids and 100 without, who gave birth at PMCH, Patna, Bihar, India between January 2023 and December 2024.
finding: Pregnant women with uterine fibroids experienced significantly higher rates of maternal complications such as preterm labor, cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, and placental abruption, as well as adverse fetal outcomes including low birth weight and increased NICU stays.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with fibroids had significantly higher rates of cesarean section.
